sloka: तमापतन्तमुत्प्लुत्य हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।आजघान तदा मूर्ध्नि वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.७०.२४ ।।
transliteration: tamāpatantamutplutya hanumān mārutātmajaḥ।ājaghāna tadā mūrdhni vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।। 6.70.24 ।।

translations.english: Then the son of wind god, Hanuman observing Devanthaka coming towards him, got up and hit him on the forehead with his thunderbolt like fist.
